subject: FinOrb onboarding — SSO/SCIM bootstrap, IP allowlist & service-account runway
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finorb.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finorb.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial: FinOrb SSO/SCIM onboarding and IP allowlist questions

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move forward. Before we schedule the implementation work, can you confirm a few technical details so we can prep our infra and procurement?

Quick list: 
- SAML metadata: do you provide a metadata XML or should we point to a relay state URL?
- SCIM attributes: we need the exact schema (which attributes are required vs optional) so our identity team can map AD/Okta.
- IP allowlist: we operate behind a firewall; please provide stable egress IP ranges for Redwood Dedicated and Hosted API.
- Service accounts: what permissions does the integration expect? Are there short-lived tokens or long-lived service keys?

We‘d like to target week of Jan 11 for cutover, but we can be flexible if you need a dry run. Also cc‘d Priya (IT) who will own the Okta mapping.

Appreciate any docs or templates you can send over.

Best,
Sam

Sam Patel
Head of IT, FinOrb
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finorb.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finorb.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: FinOrb SSO/SCIM onboarding and IP allowlist questions

Hi Sam — great to hear and thanks for outlining the questions. I pulled together a short mutual-action plan and the items we need from your side. Attaching the checklist and a draft service-account permissions doc.

High-level answers:
- SAML metadata: Redwood can provide an SP metadata XML. For Hosted deployments we host the metadata at a stable URL; for Dedicated we can generate a per-tenant metadata file. I‘ll attach the sample XML and the SAML config checklist.
- SCIM: we support SCIM v2.0. The attached checklist lists required attributes (userName, emails, active) and a recommended mapping for groups. If you have custom attributes we can add them but will need the schema and a short change window.
- IP allowlist: For Hosted API use the Hosted-egress ranges in the attachment. For Dedicated we will coordinate with your network team; Dedicated often uses a private peering path but we can provide fallback egress ranges if you plan firewall rules.
- Service accounts: We prefer short-lived OAuth tokens minted by the customer-managed service-account flow (details in the doc). For Dedicated customers, an on-prem service key option is available for automation.

Action items (from our side):
1) Ben will propose an Okta mapping template and a SCIM dry-run plan (timing: by 12/08).
2) Monica will open the onboarding MURAL and schedule a 60-min pre-cutover tech alignment (target: week of 12/20).
3) I will share a draft mutual action plan on Drive and create the HubSpot kickoff task.

Can you confirm FinOrb can share a test Okta tenant (or SAML metadata + SCIM test creds) by 12/10? That will let us run the mapping and a dry-run flow before the Jan 11 target.

Regards,
Chloe Martin
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-saml-scim-checklist.xlsx, service-account-permissions.md
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finorb.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finorb.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: FinOrb SSO/SCIM onboarding and IP allowlist questions

Hi all — quick technical notes from the infra side. Pulling together a short ops play: 

1) SCIM mapping (ok to use these as defaults):
 - required: userName (string), active (boolean), name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work,value]
 - optional / recommended: groups (array), phoneNumbers
 - rate limits: our SCIM endpoints accept up to 10 req/sec per tenant during mapping window; we recommend batching and test payloads of ~50 users first.

2) SAML specifics:
 - AssertionConsumerService (ACS) URL: https://api.redwood.com/sso/acs (Hosted) — for Dedicated we will provide tenant-specific ACS
 - NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress (default)
 - Attribute statements: we expect email and groups; if you plan email aliases point them to emails[type=work]

3) IP allowlist and staging cutover:
 - Attached is a file with the current Hosted egress CIDR blocks — these are stable for the next quarter. (see finorb-ip-list.txt)
 - For a zero-downtime cutover we recommend: a) test mode with SCIM sync to a sandbox tenant, b) SAML test with SP metadata in Okta as non-enforced, c) small pilot (10 testers), d) full cutover.

4) Service accounts and least privilege:
 - The service account only needs SCIM write scope and a token-scoped role for user provisioning. For auditability, enable token rotation at 24h. If you cannot rotate daily we can accept 7-day TTL tokens with stricter IP restrictions.

I‘ll join the pre-cutover call; Chloe — I added a short checklist in the Drive link.

—Ben

Attachment: finorb-ip-list.txt

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Priya. Short answers: 

- Hosted egress: yes, the CIDR list we provided covers both API and SCIM endpoints. I‘ll highlight that in the Drive doc so network can copy/paste.
- Dedicated peering: we need your ASN, public IP ranges, and preferred region. Once we have those we can open an internal ticket to our network team and loop in the peering ops owner. That process typically takes 2–3 weeks depending on cloud provider windows.

Next steps summary (action tracker):
 - FinOrb: provide sandbox Okta + SCIM test creds by 2026-12-09 (Sam/Priya)
 - Redwood: Ben to share SCIM test harness and rate-limit guidance (done); Chloe to schedule 12/20 tech alignment and share Drive MAP (by 12/10)
 - Both: plan dry-run the week of 01/04; target cutover 01/11.

I‘ll upload a finalized MAP to the Drive link and create the HubSpot tasks. If anything slips we can move the dry-run one week earlier or later — just flag changes in the MAP.

Thanks everyone — see you on the alignment call.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin

Redwood Inference
